		Dataset card for ITTO
	

ITTO is a challenging new benchmark suite for evaluating and diagnosing the capabilities and limitations of point tracking methods.

	
		
		Installation:
	

ITTO contains three component datasets: (1) MOSE, (2) L-VOS, (3) Ego4D. You will have to install the L-VOS and Ego4D components of the dataset individually due to licensing permissions.… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/demalenk/itto-dataset.
